BOOLEAN_DIAGNOSTIC_AVAILABLE=False
if RUN_BOOLEAN_DIAGNOSTIC:
    print({'experiment':'fixed sensor / whole window / absolute mean difference >1 normalized unit',
           'language_parser':'bypassed; target sensor selected by metadata',
           'LJR_weight':0.,'balance':'TRAIN sampling only; validation/test keep natural distribution',
           'pair_limit_per_phase':BOOLEAN_PAIR_LIMIT,'max_epochs':BOOLEAN_EPOCHS,
           'fit_budget_seconds_per_model':BOOLEAN_FIT_SECONDS},flush=True)
    preparation_started=time.perf_counter()
    BOOLEAN_TRAIN=prepare_boolean_cache(train_loaders,'train')
    BOOLEAN_VALIDATION=prepare_boolean_cache(validation_loaders,'validation')
    positive=int(BOOLEAN_TRAIN['labels'].sum()); negative=len(BOOLEAN_TRAIN['labels'])-positive
    if not positive or not negative:
        print({'diagnostic_status':'INSUFFICIENT_TRAIN_CLASSES','train_positive':positive,'train_negative':negative,
               'next':'More real eligible training comparisons are needed; no positive labels were fabricated.'})
    else:
        boolean_fusion=copy.deepcopy(gevis).to(DEVICE)
        gevis_fast.configure_boolean_fusion(boolean_fusion)
        numeric_probe=gevis_fast.BooleanNumericProbe().to(DEVICE)
        BOOLEAN_MODELS={'GEVIS_fusion':boolean_fusion,'numeric_probe':numeric_probe}
        BOOLEAN_LOGITS={'GEVIS_fusion':gevis_fast.boolean_fusion_logits,
                        'numeric_probe':lambda model,x,lengths:model(x,lengths)}
        BOOLEAN_REPORTS={}; BOOLEAN_HISTORY={}
        preparation_seconds=time.perf_counter()-preparation_started
        for method,model in BOOLEAN_MODELS.items():
            print({'phase':'boolean_fit','method':method},flush=True)
            history,report=gevis_fast.fit_boolean(model,BOOLEAN_TRAIN,BOOLEAN_VALIDATION,BOOLEAN_LOGITS[method],
                epochs=BOOLEAN_EPOCHS,learning_rate=1e-3,max_seconds=BOOLEAN_FIT_SECONDS,seed=SEED)
            BOOLEAN_HISTORY[method]=history; BOOLEAN_REPORTS[method]=report
        BOOLEAN_TEST=prepare_boolean_cache(test_loaders,'test')
        BOOLEAN_RESULTS=pd.DataFrame([{'split':split,**diagnostic_comparison(model,cache,BOOLEAN_LOGITS[method],method)}
            for split,cache in [('validation',BOOLEAN_VALIDATION),('test',BOOLEAN_TEST)]
            for method,model in BOOLEAN_MODELS.items()])
        display(BOOLEAN_RESULTS.style.hide(axis='index'))
        display(pd.DataFrame([{'method':method,**report} for method,report in BOOLEAN_REPORTS.items()]).style.hide(axis='index'))
        BOOLEAN_DIAGNOSTIC_AVAILABLE=True
        if SAVE_BOOLEAN_DIAGNOSTIC:
            diagnostic_checkpoint={'schema':'gevis.boolean_diagnostic.v1',
                'task':'selected sensor; whole window; absolute normalized mean difference >1',
                'label_kind':'deterministic numeric proxy, not verified fault',
                'encoder_artifact_version':ENCODER_ARTIFACT_VERSION,
                'encoder_hashes':{s:sha256_file(ENCODER_ROOT/'encoders'/f'{s}.pt') for s in encoders},
                'backbone_sha256':sha256_file(backbone_path),
                'helper_sha256':sha256_file(Path(gevis_fast.__file__)),
                'model_config':{'numeric_dim':NUMERIC_DIM,'d_model':CONFIG.d_model,'dropout':CONFIG.dropout},
                'fusion_state':{k:v.cpu() for k,v in boolean_fusion.state_dict().items()},
                'probe_state':{k:v.cpu() for k,v in numeric_probe.state_dict().items()},
                'pair_limit':BOOLEAN_PAIR_LIMIT,'seed':SEED,'reports':BOOLEAN_REPORTS,
                'preparation_seconds':preparation_seconds,'LJR_weight':0.,
                'train_majority_class':int(positive>negative),'validation_selection_only':True}
            save_torch(diagnostic_checkpoint,BOOLEAN_ARTIFACT_ROOT/'boolean_diagnostic.pt',OVERWRITE_BOOLEAN_DIAGNOSTIC)
            print({'saved_diagnostic':str(BOOLEAN_ARTIFACT_ROOT/'boolean_diagnostic.pt'),
                   'deployment':'diagnostic only; existing typed runtime checkpoint was not replaced'})

if RUN_INTEGRATED_EXPERIMENT:
    if SAVE_INTEGRATED_EXPERIMENT and (INTEGRATED_ARTIFACT_ROOT/'integrated_experiment.pt').exists() and not OVERWRITE_INTEGRATED_EXPERIMENT:
        raise FileExistsError('Integrated bundle already exists. Run STEP 4 to evaluate it, or explicitly set OVERWRITE_INTEGRATED_EXPERIMENT=True before retraining.')
    print({'mode':'integrated comparison','answer_types':list(gevis_fast.TYPED_SIZES),'label_reward_policy':LABEL_REWARD_POLICY,
           'paired_fit_budget_seconds':INTEGRATED_FIT_SECONDS,'preparation':'timed separately',
           'question_binding':'explicit target/operation/scope; NLP quality evaluated separately'},flush=True)
    preparation_started=time.perf_counter()
    INTEGRATED_TRAIN=prepare_integrated_cache(train_loaders,'train')
    INTEGRATED_VALIDATION=prepare_integrated_cache(validation_loaders,'validation')
    preparation_seconds=time.perf_counter()-preparation_started
    INTEGRATED_MODELS,INTEGRATED_HISTORY,INTEGRATED_REPORT=gevis_fast.fit_typed_comparison(
        gevis,INTEGRATED_TRAIN,INTEGRATED_VALIDATION,epochs=INTEGRATED_EPOCHS,
        steps_per_epoch=INTEGRATED_STEPS_PER_EPOCH,max_seconds=INTEGRATED_FIT_SECONDS,
        learning_rate=1e-3,reward_weight=LJR_WEIGHT,seed=SEED)
    INTEGRATED_CALIBRATION={}
    for method,model in INTEGRATED_MODELS.items():
        val_prob,_=gevis_fast.predict_typed(model,INTEGRATED_VALIDATION)
        INTEGRATED_CALIBRATION[method]={}
        for kind,prob in val_prob.items():
            temperature=gevis_fast.choose_temperature(prob,INTEGRATED_VALIDATION['labels'][kind])
            item={'temperature':temperature,'selection_split':'validation'}
            if kind=='BOOLEAN':
                adjusted=(prob.clamp_min(1e-8).log()/temperature).softmax(-1)
                threshold,status=gevis_fast.choose_boolean_threshold(adjusted,INTEGRATED_VALIDATION['labels'][kind],minimum_recall=MIN_VALIDATION_RECALL)
                item.update(threshold=threshold,**status)
            INTEGRATED_CALIBRATION[method][kind]=item
    INTEGRATED_CONSTANTS={}
    for kind,size in gevis_fast.TYPED_SIZES.items():
        counts=torch.bincount(INTEGRATED_TRAIN['labels'][kind],minlength=size)
        INTEGRATED_CONSTANTS[kind]={'always_first':0,'train_majority':int(counts.argmax()),
            'train_best_reward':int(INTEGRATED_TRAIN['rewards'][kind].mean(0).argmax())}
    INTEGRATED_TEST=prepare_integrated_cache(test_loaders,'test')
    all_rows=[]
    for split,cache in [('validation',INTEGRATED_VALIDATION),('test',INTEGRATED_TEST)]:
        result,_=integrated_report(INTEGRATED_MODELS,cache,INTEGRATED_CALIBRATION,split); all_rows+=result
    INTEGRATED_RESULTS=pd.DataFrame(all_rows)
    display(INTEGRATED_RESULTS.style.hide(axis='index'))
    display(pd.DataFrame(INTEGRATED_HISTORY).style.hide(axis='index'))
    print({'training':INTEGRATED_REPORT,'preparation_seconds':preparation_seconds,
           'calibration':INTEGRATED_CALIBRATION,'label_warning':'numeric proxies, not expert fault labels'})
    if SAVE_INTEGRATED_EXPERIMENT:
        checkpoint={'schema':'gevis.integrated_experiment.v1','experiment_types':list(gevis_fast.TYPED_SIZES),
            'policy':LABEL_REWARD_POLICY,'criteria':gevis_fast.TYPED_CRITERIA,
            'model_config':{'numeric_dim':NUMERIC_DIM,'d_model':CONFIG.d_model,'dropout':CONFIG.dropout},
            'models':{name:{k:v.cpu() for k,v in model.state_dict().items()} for name,model in INTEGRATED_MODELS.items()},
            'calibration':INTEGRATED_CALIBRATION,'constants':INTEGRATED_CONSTANTS,
            'report':INTEGRATED_REPORT,'history':INTEGRATED_HISTORY,'preparation_seconds':preparation_seconds,
            'pair_limit':INTEGRATED_PAIR_LIMIT,'seed':SEED,
            'encoder_artifact_version':ENCODER_ARTIFACT_VERSION,
            'encoder_hashes':{s:sha256_file(ENCODER_ROOT/'encoders'/f'{s}.pt') for s in encoders},
            'backbone_sha256':sha256_file(backbone_path),'helper_sha256':sha256_file(Path(gevis_fast.__file__)),
            'backbone_text_metrics':backbone_checkpoint['text_metrics'],
            'backbone_semantic_metrics':backbone_checkpoint['semantic_metrics'],
            'backbone_semantic_by_type':backbone_checkpoint.get('semantic_by_type',[]),
            'backbone_semantic_fixed_comparison':backbone_checkpoint.get('semantic_fixed_comparison',[]),
            'backbone_semantic_diagnostics':backbone_checkpoint.get('semantic_diagnostics',{}),
            'backbone_experiment_tag':BACKBONE_EXPERIMENT_TAG,
            'backbone_grounding_metrics':backbone_checkpoint['grounding_metrics'],
            'deployment':'experimental candidate bundle; existing runtime checkpoint preserved'}
        save_torch(checkpoint,INTEGRATED_ARTIFACT_ROOT/'integrated_experiment.pt',OVERWRITE_INTEGRATED_EXPERIMENT)
        print({'saved_integrated_bundle':str(INTEGRATED_ARTIFACT_ROOT/'integrated_experiment.pt')})

@torch.no_grad()
def prepare_boolean_cache(loaders,split,pair_limit=BOOLEAN_PAIR_LIMIT):
    records=[]; started=time.perf_counter()
    for step,loader in loaders.items():
        encoder,meta=encoders[step]; encoder=encoder.to(DEVICE).eval()
        dataset=loader.dataset
        subset=torch.utils.data.Subset(dataset,list(range(min(pair_limit,len(dataset)))))
        ordered=DataLoader(subset,CONFIG.batch_size,shuffle=False,num_workers=0)
        for current,reference,positions in ordered:
            current=current.to(DEVICE); reference=reference.to(DEVICE)
            state=numeric_state(encoder,current,reference)
            sensors=current.shape[2]; patches=state.shape[1]//sensors
            # Explicit target binding: every sensor is a separate fixed-operation question.
            selected=state.reshape(len(current),sensors,patches,state.shape[-1]).reshape(-1,patches,state.shape[-1]).cpu()
            labels=((current.mean(1)-reference.mean(1)).abs()>1.).long().flatten().cpu()
            records.append({'states':selected,'labels':labels})
        encoder.cpu()
        print({'phase':'boolean_prepare','split':split,'step':step,'elapsed_seconds':round(time.perf_counter()-started,2)},flush=True)
    return gevis_fast.pack_boolean_records(records,max_bytes=256*1024**2)

def diagnostic_comparison(model,cache,logits_fn,method):
    metrics,pred=gevis_fast.evaluate_boolean(model,cache,logits_fn)
    return {'method':method,**metrics}

@torch.no_grad()
def prepare_integrated_cache(loaders,split,pair_limit=INTEGRATED_PAIR_LIMIT,policy=LABEL_REWARD_POLICY):
    if policy['mode']!='configured_numeric_proxy': raise ValueError('Only the declared numeric proxy label contract is implemented')
    records=[]; started=time.perf_counter()
    for step_id,(step,loader) in enumerate(loaders.items()):
        encoder,meta=encoders[step]; encoder=encoder.to(DEVICE).eval()
        subset=torch.utils.data.Subset(loader.dataset,list(range(min(pair_limit,len(loader.dataset)))))
        ordered=DataLoader(subset,CONFIG.batch_size,shuffle=False,num_workers=0)
        for current,reference,positions in ordered:
            current=current.to(DEVICE); reference=reference.to(DEVICE)
            state=numeric_state(encoder,current,reference); sensors=current.shape[2]; patches=state.shape[1]//sensors
            features=semantic_comparison_features(current,reference,state,patches).permute(0,2,1,3).reshape(-1,5)
            bank=state.reshape(len(current)*sensors,patches,state.shape[-1]).cpu()
            bank_index=torch.arange(len(bank),device=DEVICE).repeat_interleave(3)
            scope=torch.arange(3,device=DEVICE).repeat(len(bank))
            statistic=(bank_index+step_id)%5
            direction=(bank_index//5+step_id)%3
            labels,rewards,scores=gevis_fast.typed_targets(features,statistic,direction,
                thresholds=policy['thresholds'],ordinal_edges=policy['ordinal_edges'],
                false_alarm_cost=policy['false_alarm_cost'],miss_cost=policy['miss_cost'])
            records.append({'states':bank,'bank_index':bank_index.cpu(),'features':scores.cpu(),
                'statistic':statistic.cpu(),'direction':direction.cpu(),'scope':scope.cpu(),
                'step_id':torch.full((len(scope),),step_id,dtype=torch.long),'labels':labels,'rewards':rewards})
        encoder.cpu()
        print({'phase':'integrated_prepare','split':split,'step':step,'elapsed_seconds':round(time.perf_counter()-started,2)},flush=True)
    return gevis_fast.pack_typed_records(records,max_bytes=256*1024**2)

def integrated_report(models,cache,calibration,split):
    rows=[]; predictions={}
    for method,model in models.items():
        probabilities,latency=gevis_fast.predict_typed(model,cache); predictions[method]=probabilities
        for kind,prob in probabilities.items():
            rows.append({'split':split,'method':method,'answer_type':kind,'variant':'raw',
                'ms_per_question_group':latency,**gevis_fast.typed_metrics(prob,cache['labels'][kind],cache['rewards'][kind],kind)})
            temperature=calibration[method][kind]['temperature']
            adjusted=(prob.clamp_min(1e-8).log()/temperature).softmax(-1)
            threshold=calibration[method][kind].get('threshold',.5)
            rows.append({'split':split,'method':method,'answer_type':kind,'variant':'validation_calibrated',
                'temperature':temperature,'threshold':threshold,'ms_per_question_group':latency,
                **gevis_fast.typed_metrics(adjusted,cache['labels'][kind],cache['rewards'][kind],kind,threshold=threshold)})
    return rows,predictions

# No STEP 1/2 training. Fit only reference criteria from existing TRAIN caches.
if RUN_STRUCTURED_EVALUATION:
    if globals().get('SESSION_SIGNATURE')!='STEP3_GEVIS_PRETRAINED_POLICY_V2': raise RuntimeError('Stale STEP3 kernel. Restart and run from the first cell.')
    from pecvd.experiments.reference_policy_v2 import (ReferenceConfig,ReferencePolicy,identity_for,
        fit_records,cached_records,save_policy,load_policy,validation_alert_rates)
    REFERENCE_CONFIG=ReferenceConfig()  # Finite-sample empirical bands, with reported coarse/tied boundaries.
    import os
    REFERENCE_PATH=Path(os.environ.get('GEVIS_REFERENCE_POLICY_PATH',str(BACKBONE_ROOT/'reference_policy_v2.json')))
    REFERENCE_IDENTITY=identity_for(ROOT,ENCODER_ROOT,backbone_path,REFERENCE_CONFIG)
    if REFERENCE_PATH.exists():
        REFERENCE_POLICY=load_policy(REFERENCE_PATH,REFERENCE_IDENTITY)
    else:
        print('Preparing reference criteria from TRAIN only; frozen encoders; no CSV read...',flush=True)
        payload=fit_records(cached_records(encoders,ENCODER_ROOT,DEVICE,numeric_state,REFERENCE_CONFIG),REFERENCE_IDENTITY,REFERENCE_CONFIG)
        REFERENCE_POLICY=ReferencePolicy(payload)
        rates=validation_alert_rates(REFERENCE_POLICY,cached_records(encoders,ENCODER_ROOT,DEVICE,numeric_state,REFERENCE_CONFIG,split='validation'))
        payload['validation_control_rates']=rates.to_dict('records')
        save_policy(payload,REFERENCE_PATH)
    REFERENCE_SUPPORT=REFERENCE_POLICY.summary()
    if REFERENCE_SUPPORT.empty: raise ValueError('No matched independent reference runs. Check TRAIN cache cohort/position/run support; no fixed-threshold fallback.')
    display(REFERENCE_SUPPORT.groupby(['step','group_level','direction']).agg(groups=('sensor','size'),
        base_supported=('base_quantile_supported','sum'),ordinal_supported=('ordinal_quantiles_supported','sum')).reset_index())
    print('Reference criteria ready. Final discovery alert rates are reported below, after window calibration.')
    print('Reference criteria saved/validated. Generic localization and shared-runtime discovery evaluation follow.')

# Prepare 90/95/99 thresholds from identical TRAIN/Validation records; never Test.
if RUN_STRUCTURED_EVALUATION:
    import importlib, os
    import pecvd.experiments.pipeline_settings as pipeline_settings
    pipeline_settings=importlib.reload(pipeline_settings)
    if 'ROOT' in globals(): PIPELINE_SETTINGS=pipeline_settings.configure_pipeline(ROOT)
    # Refresh leaves BEFORE importing WindowConfig or comparison functions.
    for _module_name in ('window_policy', 'position_rank_policy', 'discovery_calibration'):
        importlib.reload(importlib.import_module('pecvd.experiments.' + _module_name))
    import pecvd.experiments.threshold_comparison as threshold_comparison
    threshold_comparison=importlib.reload(threshold_comparison)
    prepare_comparison=threshold_comparison.prepare_comparison
    comparison_table=threshold_comparison.comparison_table
    from pecvd.experiments.window_policy import WindowConfig
    WINDOW_CONFIG=WindowConfig(scale_quantile=.95,nominal_window_alert_rate=PIPELINE_SETTINGS.get('control_alert_budget',1-PIPELINE_SETTINGS['active_quantile']),
        gate_scope=PIPELINE_SETTINGS.get("gate_profile","full_window"),noise_scale_floor=PIPELINE_SETTINGS.get("gate_profile")=="center_views_v3",
        threshold_multiplier=PIPELINE_SETTINGS.get("threshold_multiplier",1.0),
        operation_profile=PIPELINE_SETTINGS.get('operation_profile','all'),
        max_calibration_windows_per_step=PIPELINE_SETTINGS.get('max_calibration_windows_per_step',2048),
        local_width=9,max_lag=4,merge_gap=1,min_duration=2,
        min_train_runs=8,min_validation_runs=4,max_windows_per_step=256,max_references=16,seed=SEED)
    WINDOW_CONFIG.validate()
    os.environ['GEVIS_GATE_PROFILE']=WINDOW_CONFIG.gate_scope
    os.environ['GEVIS_THRESHOLD_MULTIPLIER']=str(WINDOW_CONFIG.threshold_multiplier)
    os.environ['GEVIS_OPERATION_PROFILE']=WINDOW_CONFIG.operation_profile
    print({'preparing_gate_scope': WINDOW_CONFIG.gate_scope, 'operation_profile': WINDOW_CONFIG.operation_profile, 'threshold_multiplier': WINDOW_CONFIG.threshold_multiplier})
    if WINDOW_CONFIG.operation_profile=='core': print('Enabled: level_shift, drift, spike, variance. Disabled: stuck, delay, relationship.')
    WINDOW_POLICIES=prepare_comparison(encoders,ENCODER_ROOT,backbone_path,DEVICE,numeric_state,config=WINDOW_CONFIG)
    WINDOW_POLICY=WINDOW_POLICIES[PIPELINE_SETTINGS['active_quantile']]
    WINDOW_POLICY_PATH=pipeline_settings.activate_prepared_policy(backbone_path,PIPELINE_SETTINGS['active_quantile'])
    print(f'Active discovery policy: {WINDOW_POLICY_PATH}')
    display(comparison_table({PIPELINE_SETTINGS['active_quantile']:WINDOW_POLICY}))
    print('Identical thresholds are legitimate with few controls. 99% is not a fault probability or a certified 1% false-alarm rate.')

    # Fit one direct GMM boundary on TRAIN, retaining q99 as the default policy.
    if globals().get('RUN_GMM_COMPARISON',True):
        from types import SimpleNamespace
        import pecvd.experiments.gmm_comparison as gmm_comparison
        gmm_comparison=importlib.reload(gmm_comparison)
        GMM_PREP_RUNTIME=SimpleNamespace(encoders=encoders,module=SimpleNamespace(
            DISCOVERY_POLICY=WINDOW_POLICY,ENCODER_ROOT=ENCODER_ROOT,BACKBONE_PATH=backbone_path,
            DEVICE=DEVICE,numeric_state=numeric_state))
        try:
            GMM_DIRECT_POLICY=gmm_comparison.prepare_gmm(GMM_PREP_RUNTIME)
        except gmm_comparison.GMMNotIdentifiable as error:
            GMM_DIRECT_POLICY=None
            display(pd.DataFrame(error.diagnostics))
            print(str(error))
        else:
            display(pd.DataFrame(GMM_DIRECT_POLICY.bundle['diagnostics']))

# Offline STEP3 only. This head cannot change alert/support/sensor ranking.
if RUN_TEMPORAL_LOCALIZATION_TRAINING:
    from types import SimpleNamespace
    import pecvd.experiments.temporal_localization as temporal_localization
    temporal_localization=importlib.reload(temporal_localization)
    LOCALIZATION_RUNTIME=SimpleNamespace(ENCODER_ROOT=ENCODER_ROOT,BACKBONE_PATH=backbone_path,
        STEP_ENCODERS=encoders,DEVICE=DEVICE,numeric_state=numeric_state)
    TEMPORAL_LOCALIZER=temporal_localization.prepare_localizer(LOCALIZATION_RUNTIME)
    print('Temporal localizer prepared; Test is reserved for STEP4. Numeric interval baseline is retained.')

# Fit a real decision head on TRAIN; calibrate/compare on disjoint Validation runs.
# Retain full STEP1/STEP2 and Cross-Attention. Save only if the acceptance rule passes.
if RUN_STRUCTURED_EVALUATION and globals().get("RUN_LEARNED_CENTER_TRAINING", True) and EVALUATION_MODE == "center" and globals().get('PIPELINE_SETTINGS', {}).get('gate_profile') != 'position_rank_v4':
    import importlib
    from pecvd.experiments.routing_audit import refresh_evaluation_modules
    refresh_evaluation_modules()
    from pecvd.experiments.center_decision import CenterConfig, candidate_path
    from pecvd.experiments.center_training import train_center_decision
    from pecvd.experiments.reporting import ready_runtime
    CENTER_CONFIG = CenterConfig()
    CENTER_CANDIDATE_PATH = candidate_path(backbone_path, CENTER_CONFIG)
    if CENTER_CANDIDATE_PATH.is_file():
        print("Accepted learned center candidate exists; runtime verifies exact identity before use.")
        os.environ["GEVIS_CENTER_DECISION_PATH"] = str(CENTER_CANDIDATE_PATH)
    else:
        CENTER_HEAD, CENTER_DECISION_REPORT = train_center_decision(
            ROOT, runtime=ready_runtime(ROOT), config=CENTER_CONFIG, save_accepted=True)
        display(CENTER_DECISION_REPORT.summary)
        display(CENTER_DECISION_REPORT.diagnostics["by_kind"])
        print(CENTER_DECISION_REPORT.metadata)
        print("Rejected candidates do not replace the current model or produce a checkpoint.")

# Execute exactly the inference path used by STEP 3.1 / STEP 4 / EXP.
if RUN_STRUCTURED_EVALUATION:
    import importlib
    import pecvd.experiments.routing_audit as runtime_refresh
    runtime_refresh=importlib.reload(runtime_refresh)
    runtime_refresh.refresh_evaluation_modules()
    from pecvd.experiments.gevis_system import run_gevis_experiment as run_discovery_experiment
    DISCOVERY_VALIDATION=run_discovery_experiment(ROOT,split='validation',
        pairs_per_step=2,max_cases=7,seed=SEED,evaluate_centers=True,analysis_mode=EVALUATION_MODE)
    print('Validation overlaps temporal selection; not an unbiased localization performance estimate.')
    display(DISCOVERY_VALIDATION.summary)
    display(DISCOVERY_VALIDATION.by_step)
    display(DISCOVERY_VALIDATION.diagnostics['localization_metrics'])
    print('Known injected changes measure detection and localization; untouched controls are unlabelled, so their alert rate is not a verified fault false-positive rate.')

    if 'center_analysis' in DISCOVERY_VALIDATION.diagnostics: display(DISCOVERY_VALIDATION.diagnostics['center_analysis'])


    print(DISCOVERY_VALIDATION.metadata["analysis_mode"])
    for _diagnostic in ("partner_ranking", "gate_bottlenecks", "intervention_validity", "dynamic_challenge", "dynamic_challenge_controls", "contract"):
        if _diagnostic in DISCOVERY_VALIDATION.diagnostics: display(DISCOVERY_VALIDATION.diagnostics[_diagnostic])

if RUN_STRUCTURED_EVALUATION and globals().get('RUN_GMM_COMPARISON',True):
    from pecvd.experiments.gmm_comparison import run_boundary_comparison
    try:
        BOUNDARY_VALIDATION=run_boundary_comparison(ROOT,baseline_report=DISCOVERY_VALIDATION,
            split='validation',pairs_per_step=2,max_cases=7,seed=SEED,
            evaluate_centers=True,analysis_mode=EVALUATION_MODE)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        display(pd.DataFrame([{'boundary':'gmm_direct','status':'NOT_PREPARED',
            'reason':'Inspect GMM TRAIN support in window-evidence-build; q99 retained.'}]))
    else:
        display(BOUNDARY_VALIDATION.summary)
        display(BOUNDARY_VALIDATION.by_step)
        display(BOUNDARY_VALIDATION.diagnostics['by_kind'])
        display(BOUNDARY_VALIDATION.diagnostics['common_support'])
        print('Validation diagnostic only. q99 remains the default; GMM is direct mixture assignment, not fault probability.')

if RUN_STRUCTURED_EVALUATION and globals().get('RUN_THRESHOLD_SENSITIVITY',False):
    import importlib
    import pecvd.experiments.routing_audit as runtime_refresh
    runtime_refresh=importlib.reload(runtime_refresh)
    runtime_refresh.refresh_evaluation_modules()
    # Same frozen model/cases; only the final window threshold changes.
    from pecvd.experiments.threshold_comparison import run_threshold_comparison
    THRESHOLD_COMPARISON=run_threshold_comparison(PIPELINE_ROOT,
        split=PIPELINE_SETTINGS['comparison_split'],pairs_per_step=2,max_cases=14,seed=42)
    display(THRESHOLD_COMPARISON.summary)
    display(THRESHOLD_COMPARISON.by_step)
    display(THRESHOLD_COMPARISON.diagnostics['thresholds'])
    if 'center_gate_audit' in THRESHOLD_COMPARISON.diagnostics: display(THRESHOLD_COMPARISON.diagnostics['center_gate_audit'])
    display(THRESHOLD_COMPARISON.diagnostics['by_kind_and_strength'])
    for _key in ('position_calibration', 'relaxation_effect', 'paired_change_summary', 'paired_change_diagnosis', 'experimental_support', 'dynamic_challenge_controls'):
        if _key in THRESHOLD_COMPARISON.diagnostics: display(THRESHOLD_COMPARISON.diagnostics[_key])
